meta.title: With partial awarding off, a second vendor cannot be added to a line already fully awarded
gaps: The available vocabulary does not expose a setting change or assertion for partial awarding being off.
The available vocabulary does not expose the award response body needed to explicitly omit the quantity; the plan relies on award_vendor using the vendor's quoted quantity.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where two QA vendors bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for a second QA vendor.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: With partial awarding off, a second vendor cannot be added to a line already fully awarded

expected.message: You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.
